channel.title: VidyuthLabs Blog
channel.description: Portable potentiostats, screen-printed electrode sensors and field testing of water, food and soil.

item.title: VidyuthLabs and BITS Pilani, Hyderabad Campus collaborate on portable electrochemical sensing
item.description: VidyuthLabs is collaborating with BITS Pilani, Hyderabad Campus to develop portable potentiostat applications, starting with heavy-metal sensors for water, food and soil.

item.title: What is a portable potentiostat? A practical guide for field electrochemistry
item.description: How a potentiostat works, what CV, DPV and EIS measure, and what to look for in a portable or handheld potentiostat for field testing.

item.title: Testing drinking water for lead, cadmium, arsenic and mercury: limits and on-site methods
item.description: Indian (BIS IS 10500) and WHO limits for heavy metals in drinking water, how labs test for them, and how portable electrochemical sensors screen water on site.

item.title: Screen-printed electrodes (SPEs) explained: how they work and why they matter for sensing
item.description: What screen-printed electrodes are, the working, reference and counter electrodes on a single strip, electrode materials, nanomaterial coatings, and where SPE sensors are used.

item.title: Formalin in fish: why it is used, why it is harmful, and how to screen for it
item.description: Why formalin is illegally added to fish and seafood, the health risk, why some fish contain natural formaldehyde, and the options for rapid on-site screening.

item.title: Heavy metals in food and soil: why testing matters and how portable sensors help
item.description: How heavy metals reach crops and food, Indian food-safety rules on contaminants, how soil and food samples are prepared, and where portable electrochemical sensors fit.
